004-11. IF WE JUST THINK ABOUT THE RISK OF BEINGTOTALLY ANNIHILATED AND GROWTH EFFICIENCY.
004-12. WE DON'T HAVE ENOUGH MEMBERS, THOUGH?
004-13. THE MASTER WILL SORT OUTTHE REMAININGMEMBERS HIMSELF.

004-15. THE GAP IN ABILITIES WITHIN THE PARTY WAS TOO BIG,
004-16. AND THE PARTY WAS IN DANGER WHEN GIOE AND HANSEN COULON'T KEEP UP.

005-2. BUT THE NUMBER OF PARTIES NEEDED FOR A MISSION WILL INCREASE LATER ON.
005-3. IN A SPECIAL MISSION, TENS OR EVEN HUNOREOS OF HEROES WOULD BE NEEDEO.
005-4. IT'LL BE A PROBLEM IF THEY'RE NOT AROUND THE SAME LEVELS,
005-5. ANO THERE'S A NEEO TO BUILO A SECONDARY PARTY IN CASE THE MAIN PARTY IS ANNIHILATEO DUE TO AN UNEXPECTEO SITUATION.
